_comment: Closed noun extension (ES/EN/PT), one concept per row. Selected by frequency of UNACCOUNTED tokens over dev200 + golden_r + blind10-12 + arena seeds (2026-10-13); blind13/14 were held out and used only to evaluate. A noun here becomes an ENTITY node in the graph (represented, so a change of object is a change of meaning) - it is never an ignore list. Regexes are matched on accent-stripped lowercase tokens. Deliberately NOT included: alert/notification (light-verb objects: 'send an alert' = 'notify', pinned by test_bug033). Also NOT included: invoice/factura/fatura - it is the designated out-of-lexicon exemplar of benchmarks/sil5x100_eval.py (silent-loss ground truth) and of docs/EXTENSION_GUIDE.md's worked example; both would lose their premise.
